title: Close Utawakui
responseError: The close action could not be completed. Try again.

modal.backgroundDetail: Playback, the OBS connection and output continue. Reopen or quit from the system tray.
modal.separationDetail: Quitting cancels the current song and does not keep the rest of the queue.

native.backgroundDetail: Playback, the OBS connection and output stay on. Open or quit from the system tray.
native.separationDetail: Stopping cancels the current song; the rest of the queue is not kept.
native.saveFailed: Could not save the close behavior
native.saveFailedDetail: The window stays open. Try again later, or choose again in Settings.
native.trayUnavailableDetail: The system tray is unavailable, so the window stays open. Try again later.
